title.zh: 国际组织（豁免与特权）（INTELSAT）命令
title.vi: Lệnh Tổ chức quốc tế (Quyền miễn trừ và đặc quyền) (INTELSAT)
title.th: คำสั่งองค์การระหว่างประเทศ (ความคุ้มกันและเอกสิทธิ์) (INTELSAT)
title.id: Perintah Organisasi Internasional (Kekebalan dan Hak Istimewa) (INTELSAT)

completenessNote: 全文，共 9 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (INTELSAT) Order.
2. INTELSAT is an organisation of the nature indicated in section 2(1) of the Act.

heading.en: Immunity from suit and legal process

text.en:
3.—(1) INTELSAT shall have immunity from suit and legal process for the activities undertaken by the INTELSAT Asia-Pacific Regional Support Centre as listed in the Schedule.
(2) Nothing in sub-paragraph (1) shall be construed as granting to INTELSAT immunity from suit and legal process for contravention of the Telecommunications Act (Cap. 323).

heading.en: Inviolability of official archives and premises

text.en:
4.—(1) INTELSAT shall have the like inviolability of official archives and premises occupied as offices as is accorded in respect of the official archives and premises of an envoy of a foreign sovereign Power accredited to the Republic of Singapore.
(2) Notwithstanding sub-paragraph (1), INTELSAT shall not permit its premises to be used as a refuge for avoiding arrest under the laws of Singapore or in any other manner incompatible with the purposes of the Asia-Pacific Regional Support Centre.

heading.en: Exemption and relief from certain taxes and rates

text.en: 5. INTELSAT shall have the like exemption or relief from taxes and rates, other than import, export or excise duties, on any article as is accorded to a foreign sovereign Power.

chapter.en: PART II MANAGER OF THE INTELSAT ASIA-PACIFIC REGIONAL SUPPORT CENTRE

heading.en: Immunity and exemptions for Manager of INTELSAT

text.en:
6.—(1) Except in so far as any particular case in which any privilege or immunity is waived, the Manager shall enjoy within and with respect to the territory of Singapore immunity from suit and legal process in respect of acts, including words spoken or written, done in his official capacity and in the discharge of his duties.
(2) Immunity from suit and legal process under sub-paragraph (1) shall apply only for so long as he holds the office or employment as Manager and shall no longer apply when he ceases to hold such office or employment.
(3) Nothing in sub-paragraph (1) shall be construed as granting to the Manager immunity from suit and legal process for contravention of the Telecommunications Act (Cap. 323).
(4) For the purposes of the application of this Order, “Manager” means the Manager of the INTELSAT Asia-Pacific Regional Support Centre appointed by INTELSAT.
(5) This paragraph shall not confer any immunity or privilege upon any person who is a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore.

7. The name of the person to whom the provisions of paragraph 6 apply shall be set forth in a list compiled and published from time to time by the President under section 2(3) of the Act, and such list shall show in regard to the aforementioned person the date as from which, for the purposes of this Order, he first held the office or employment in question, and the date when he ceased to hold that office or employment.

heading.en: Changes in constitutional structure and activities

text.en: 8. Nothing in this Order shall be construed as precluding the President from declining to accord the immunities and privileges referred to in this Order, when either the constitutional structure of INTELSAT or the activities of the Asia-Pacific Regional Support Centre or both, that exist at the time of the making of this Order cease to exist or become subject to modifications.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 3(1)
Activities of the Intelsat Asia-pacific Regional Support Centre
The activities to be undertaken by the INTELSAT Asia-Pacific Regional Support Centre referred to in paragraph 3 of this Order are as follows:
1.Provision of information related to INTELSAT services and capabilities.
2.Assistance to customers in identifying effective operational and technical solutions, in terms of space segment and earth segment.
3.Technical assistance when specifying earth segment facilities.
4.Earth station application or verification assistance.
5.Enhanced resources and support for staff training.
6.Coordination of regional business development activities.
7.Support for the introduction of new technologies and services.
8.Generation and analysis of regional market information.
9.Promotion and development of INTELSAT business.
